sample_from_logits: sample an action from model logits using categorical sampling with an optional temperature parameter
nucleus_sample_actions: perform nucleus sampling on logits by filtering with a top_p threshold before sampling
mask_logits_with_bias: mask unavailable action logits by applying a large negative bias where the mask is false
finalize_logits_with_temperature_and_mas: apply temperature scaling and masking to logits in a single step before sampling
apply_temperature_to_logits: scale logits by dividing by a temperature value to control sampling randomness
